item.title: Freezing Rain May Cause Slick Travel Early Tuesday Morning
item.description: The National Weather Service Milwaukee/Sullivan Weather Forecast Office indicates that “Near freezing temps paired with incoming precipitation chances may result in patchy light freezing rain/drizzle and slick spots overnight into early Tuesday morning.” Timing it expected to be between 2 a.m. and 7 a.m. Tuesday.

item.description: The University of Wisconsin-Whitewater will host a NCAA women’s basketball regional for the sixth consecutive championship this weekend.
